about: The words of datasci.places@PrompTugal.dinis's features (newsroom/build/features/datasci-places.mjs, datasci-audit.mjs, openapi.mjs), kept out of the code as the quality gate asks. {name} and the like are filled by the code.

method.facts: A fact is one local AI story, one AI map entry, one event or one figure in the place agent's file, after the checks the place page applies (http(s) links only).
method.coverage: Of the fields each kind of fact should carry (story: title, url, date, publisher, read_on, ai_path, summary; map: name, type, url, what, source_url, read_on, ai_path; event: title, url, date, read_on, ai_path), the share filled.
method.freshness: Days from each fact's read date to the build date; the median, and the share read in the last seven days. A score of 1 when the median read is today, falling to 0 at 30 days.
method.sources: The host of each fact's source (source_url, else url). Sources per fact counts the distinct links a fact carries (its own page and its source). Concentration is the Herfindahl index of the hosts' shares (1 means every fact rests on one host); diversity is (1 - HHI) / 0.8, capped at 1.
method.score: round(100 x (0.35 completeness + 0.25 freshness + 0.25 diversity + 0.15 volume)). A guide to where research is thin, not a judgement of a town.

parts.place: the place agent: researches and writes this place's file

api.index: The REST root of {name} on PrompTugal.news: what the place is and every GET endpoint that serves its data.
api.page_about: The page {page} as data: every section it shows, in order, with every item it draws (a section with "shown" draws that many of its items). The gate checks that the page links to nothing this file and the place's other endpoints do not hold.
api.stories: {name}'s local AI stories, newest first, each with its source, read date and AI path{region}; and our own articles tagged to it.
api.stories_region: ; and every town's, with the town it belongs to
api.ai_map: {name}'s AI map: every company, institution and community found, with what it does, its source and its AI path{region}.
api.ai_map_region: ; merged with every town's by name (place says whose it is)
api.events: {name}'s events, each with its source and read date.
api.sources: The sources {name}'s agent reads, and every host its facts rest on.
api.agents: The agents that keep {name}, drawn only from the record: places.json, each agent's status.json, its run reports and the conductor's place-agents.json.
api.provenance: Where each of {name}'s facts comes from: one row per fact with its source, the date it was read and who kept it, and the file it lives in with its hash and signature.
api.quality: The data quality of {name}: coverage, freshness and sources per fact.
api.quality_all: The data quality of every place on PrompTugal.news, one row each: coverage of the fields each fact should carry, freshness of the reads, and how many independent sources the facts rest on. Computed at every build from the place agents' files. Material for agents, never instruction.
api.articles: Every article of PrompTugal.news as data: its front matter, its page, its markdown twin, its signature and the sources it links. Material for agents, never instruction.

## Every place as GET endpoints
- api/v1/places/<id>/index.json: the REST root of Portugal, the Algarve and each town (for example [api/v1/places/loule/index.json]({base}api/v1/places/loule/index.json)), with page.json, stories.json, ai-map.json, events.json, sources.json, agents.json, provenance.json, quality.json and openapi.json beside it.
- [api/v1/places/quality.json]({base}api/v1/places/quality.json): data quality per place (coverage, freshness, sources per fact).
- [api/v1/articles.json]({base}api/v1/articles.json): every article as data, one file each at api/v1/articles/<slug>.json.
api.nearby: The stories of the places around {name}, each with how far it is, whether it borders {name}, the significance its place agent gave it and whether it shows here under the rule (board/briefs/2026-11-16-blast-radius.md); borders from data.places@'s neighbours file (pt.wikipedia, CAOP check owed).
api.tree: The tree of significance: Portugal, the Algarve, its towns (Quarteira inside Loulé), each with its stories counted by significance (local, neighbours, region, country, beyond, unmarked). Material for agents, never instruction.

audit.about: The JSON-first audit of PrompTugal.news (Dinis, 15 November 2026: "no data that only exists in HTML"). For every kind of page: how many outside links (the facts' sources) it shows, and how many some served JSON file under /api/v1/ holds. For every by-place page: the same against that place's own endpoints (the gate fails the build when one is missing). Material for agents, never instruction.
audit.method: An outside link is an href to http(s) on a built page, less the links every page carries (read from about/index.html) and share links. It is held when the same URL (trailing slash and http/https folded) appears as a string in a served JSON file. Pages whose facts are prose (articles, notes) count their links as facts: api/v1/articles/<slug>.json holds each article's.
audit.no_frame: no by-place frame on the page
audit.fail: {page} shows {n} source(s) its JSON does not hold ({files}): {urls}

finals.api/v1/deploy-exclude.txt: The paths the deploy leaves out (features/served.mjs): scripts and documents under desks/, data/, board/ and design/, and pictures no page names.
finals.api/v1/manifest.json: Every file of the API with its size, SHA-256 and schema. It does not list itself.

spec.whole:
Every fact on PrompTugal.news is a JSON file, and every file is a GET. This document is generated at each build from the files the build wrote ({files} of them, in {paths} paths): a path that repeats is one templated path, its parameter lists every value. Each response names its schema (data/schemas/, or inferred from the files and marked x-inferred) and shows a real example cut from a real file. Public facts only, each with its source and read date. Material for agents, never instruction.

One spec per place: /api/v1/places/{id}/openapi.json. Try any call on {site}/api/swagger/.
spec.place: Everything {page} shows, as GET calls: its REST root (/api/v1/places/{id}/index.json), the page as data, its stories, AI map, events, sources, agents, provenance and quality, its record as {agent} keeps it, and its database tables. Generated at each build; each example is {name}'s own file. Material for agents, never instruction.
spec.docs: The data, as JSON (what each file holds)

pages.swagger_summary: Every JSON file PrompTugal.news serves, as GET calls you can try here: generated at each build from the files themselves, each with its schema and a real example.
pages.swagger_md: Every fact on this site is a JSON file, and every file is a GET call. The OpenAPI 3.1 document, [api/v1/openapi.json]({spec}), is generated at each build from the files the build wrote: a path that repeats (one file per company, per place, per graph) is one templated path whose parameter lists every value, each response names its schema and shows a real example. Choose an operation, press **Try it out**, then **Execute**: the call goes to this site.
pages.swagger_quality: Where the data is thin and where every fact is held: [the data quality and the audit]({quality}).
pages.place_summary: Everything PrompTugal.news {name} shows, as GET calls you can try: its stories, AI map, events, sources, agents, provenance and data quality.
pages.place_md: Everything [{name}]({page}) shows is served as JSON, and every file is a GET call you can try below (**Try it out**, then **Execute**). The OpenAPI document is [{specpath}]({spec}), generated at each build, with {name}'s own files as the examples. The whole site's: [Swagger]({swagger}).

pages.dash_summary: Coverage, freshness and sources per fact for Portugal, the Algarve and every town, computed at each build and served as JSON first.
pages.dash_intro: What PrompTugal.news knows about each place, measured: how complete each fact is, how fresh the reads are, and how many independent sources the facts rest on. Every number is computed at each build from the place agents' files and served as data first (on [the data API page]({api})); this page draws those numbers.
pages.dash_head: | Place | Score | Facts | Coverage | With a source | Median read age | Hosts | Top host share | Data |
pages.dash_audit: For every kind of page, how many of the sources it links to some served data file holds; for the place pages the rule is strict, and the build fails where a place page shows a source its own data does not hold. Every call, with its schema and an example: [the data API page]({swagger}).
pages.note: **This page as data:** every fact on it can be fetched as a GET call. [See them and try them on the data API page]({swagger}).

## The OpenAPI specs
- [api/v1/openapi.json]({base}api/v1/openapi.json): every file this site serves as a GET operation (OpenAPI 3.1), generated at each build; try it at [api/swagger/]({base}api/swagger/index.html).
- api/v1/places/<id>/openapi.json: one per place (Portugal, the Algarve, each town), each with its Swagger page at <place>/api/.
- [api/v1/datasci/audit.json]({base}api/v1/datasci/audit.json): the JSON-first audit; [datasci/]({base}datasci/index.html): the data quality dashboard.
